topic: Pure Substances: Elements, Compounds, and Molecules
key_concepts: Matter is classified according to its composition
Pure substances have fixed composition and identical properties
Elements are composed of atoms with a unique number of protons
Atomic number identifies an element and equals its number of protons
Elements cannot be divided into simpler substances but can react to form new substances
Compounds are two or more elements chemically combined in definite fixed ratios
Compounds often have properties different from their constituent elements
Elements occur across Earth's atmosphere, geosphere, hydrosphere, and biosphere
